records.title: FUNDING AND BUDGET ALLOCATION FOR PURI AIRPORT
details:
(a) to (d): In September, 2023, MoCA granted Site Clearance approval to State Government of Odisha for development of 
Greenfield Airport at Puri, Odisha. In October, 2024, application for grant of 'In-Principle' approval along with Detailed Project Report & other requisite documents have been received from State Government of Odisha. 
The timeline for completion of the airport projects depends upon many factors such as land acquisition, availability of mandatory clearances, financial closure 
etc.

records.title: SMART CITIES MISSION – STATUS AND CHALLENGES
details:
As on 11.07.2025, in the 100 cities selected under Smart Cities Mission (SCM), out of a total
8063 projects amounting to ₹ 1,64,695 crore, 7,636 projects (95% of total projects) amounting
to ₹1,53,977 crore have been completed and the remaining 427 projects amounting to ₹10,718
crore are ongoing.
